description: Code Engine fleets: large pools of workers that process a queue of tasks. create returns fleet_id, which every other action takes. Call get_schema with name ce_fleet for every action's fields.

action.description: list: List fleets. | get: Get one fleet. Needs fleet_id. | create: Create a fleet from an image; name is the new fleet name. Needs name, image. | add_tasks: Queue tasks on a fleet. Needs fleet_id, tasks. | tasks: List tasks, or one with task_id. Needs fleet_id. | workers: List workers, or one with worker_name. Needs fleet_id. | cancel: Cancel a running fleet. Needs fleet_id. | delete: Delete a fleet. Needs fleet_id.

env_vars.description: Environment variables as an object of name: value.

fleet_id.description: Fleet id, from ce_fleet action list or create.

image_secret.description: Registry secret that can pull the image (a ce_secret with format registry).

project_id.description: Project id or name, from ce_project action list.

tasks.description: Task objects as required by the Code Engine API

name: ce_fleet
